data.case_title: Rejection of rehabilitation application by Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn
data.explanation: The pension insurer (Rentenversicherung) has turned down your request for inpatient medical rehabilitation, saying outpatient physiotherapy is enough for now. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the office listed — the app will show the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. You can also simply apply again later if your condition gets worse. Since the decision is medical, you may want advice from your doctor or a patient advice service before deciding whether to object.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) against the rejection
items.action: If you disagree with the rejection, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, or declare it in person for the record (zur Niederschrift) at their office, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the rejection of your rehabilitation application becomes final and binding.
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.

items.title: Reapply if your condition worsens
items.action: If your symptoms get worse later on, you can submit a new rehabilitation application to the pension insurer at any time.
items.quote: Verschlechtern sich Ihre Beschwerden, können Sie jederzeit einen neuen Antrag stellen.

key_facts.label: Deemed delivery rule
key_facts.quote: Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.

data.summary: Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn (Abteilung Rehabilitation) rejected Johanna Beispielacker's application for inpatient medical rehabilitation, stating that outpatient physiotherapy is sufficient. The decision is dated 18 November 2026 and was dispatched on 21 November 2026; an objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of deemed delivery.
